subject: Demo timing request: align with CAPEX window and executive roadshow
messages:
From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@oakridge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: FinOps Team <finops@oakridge.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to move next week’s demo — CAPEX timing + exec travel

Marissa,

Quick note — we really want to see the Prod demo, but CFO is now traveling the week you proposed and FinOps has asked us to pause any new spend discussions until the CAPEX window re-opens (expected by end of May). Can we push the live demo to a date after the next CAPEX committee meeting? If possible, also avoid the week of 5/22 when our CTO will be at an offsite.

I know this complicates schedules — happy to take a shorter technical preview earlier for the engineering team if that helps.

Thanks,
James Sullivan
VP Product, Oakridge Health
j.sullivan@oakridge.com

Date: 2028-05-14T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week’s demo — CAPEX timing + exec travel

Hi James —

Totally understand. Thanks for the heads-up and for the timeline attachment — super helpful. We can do either:

- A condensed 30-min technical preview for your engineers this week (we can run it asynchronously if that helps with timezones), OR
- Full live demo after your CAPEX committee clears the window.

If you prefer we hold until post-CAPEX, what is the earliest week that looks safe on your side? We have availability the weeks of 6/5 and 6/12 for a full session.

Connor — can you put together a 30-min script focused on core perf/cost levers so we can offer the short preview? Neha, can we prepare an updated SOW draft that reflects a potential June kickoff? I attached the baseline SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Marissa / Neha / Aditya —

Draft outline for the short preview (30 minutes):
- 5 min: quick context and goals (Marissa)
- 10 min: live walkthrough of latency and batching on a 2k token demonstration (Connor)
- 7 min: how caching and routing lower unit cost for predictable workloads (Connor)
- 5 min: Q&A + next steps (All)

Notes: keep slides to max 6. Will need a quick test dataset from Oakridge engineering — can use a redacted sample if they can’t share PHI. If they ask about timeline/procurement, Neha can speak to Dedicated vs Hosted options.
